title: PolyArbX
tagline: AI-powered copy trading & arbitrage platform for smarter, automated prediction market profits.
description:
PolyArbX is an AI-driven cross-market trading platform (Telegram Bot + Web App) that unifies copy trading, arbitrage detection, and smart order routing across prediction markets like Polymarket, Kalshi, and Probo.

It enables users to automatically copy top traders, detect arbitrage opportunities, and execute trades on the most profitable market in real time — powered by autonomous AI agents and on-chain automation.

🧩 Core Product Layers
🔹 Layer 1 — Copy Trading Engine

Users connect their Polymarket API keys to discover and follow top-performing traders.
PolyArbX mirrors their trades in real time while tracking performance curves, ROI, and risk metrics.

🔹 Layer 2 — Arbitrage Detection & Execution

The platform continuously monitors identical outcomes across markets (e.g., “ETH > $3K = 65% on Polymarket vs 70% on Kalshi”).
When a profitable spread is detected, PolyArbX alerts users or auto-executes risk-free arbitrage trades instantly.

🔹 Layer 3 — Smart Routing (Innovation Layer)

When copying trades, PolyArbX checks for better pricing across markets — executing, for instance, a Polymarket trade on Kalshi if the odds are more favorable.
This smart routing engine allows users to outperform even the traders they copy, creating a next-generation copy trading experience.

🧠 Why Use PolyArbX

✅ Combines social trading, AI automation, and cross-market arbitrage
✅ Delivers higher returns via intelligent smart routing
✅ Drives user engagement through top trader networks and leaderboards
✅ Generates valuable data assets for prediction market analytics
✅ Seamlessly integrates Lit Protocol, Fetch.ai, Pyth Network, and Lighthouse for secure, autonomous, and data-rich operation
how_its_made:
PolyArbX is an intelligent trading platform built with React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, combining copy trading, market arbitrage detection, and smart trade routing across multiple prediction markets.

The system empowers users to securely connect their trading accounts and automatically mirror top-performing traders while detecting and executing profitable arbitrage opportunities across platforms — maximizing returns with minimal effort.

⚙️ Architecture Overview

Telegram Bot: Enables real-time copy trading and arbitrage execution.

Web App: Provides a monitoring and simulation dashboard for users to track copy trades, trader performance, and  analytics.

🧩 Core Integrations

Lit Protocol:
Encrypts user API keys and enables secure, trustless automation via Lit Actions, ensuring privacy and execution integrity.

Fetch.ai:
Deploys autonomous AI agents that continuously monitor market conditions, evaluate trader performance, and execute trades when profitable opportunities arise.

Pyth Network:
Supplies high-frequency, real-time price feeds essential for precision in arbitrage detection and minimizing slippage.

Lighthouse:
Generates synthetic data to test strategies, optimize AI models, and maintain transparent trader performance analytics.

Blockscout:
Provides on-chain visibility for all trade executions, ensuring transparent tracking and auditability.

PayPal USD (PYUSD):
Integrated for seamless deposits and payouts, offering a familiar and stable payment experience for users.
